title: DateTime Library
description: Master the DateTime library for working with timestamps, date calculations, and time-based test logic.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "Ship operations are time-critical—cooldown periods, timeout calculations, scheduled diagnostics. The DateTime library handles all time operations: get current time, calculate durations, add/subtract time, format dates."
story.context: DateTime library provides time manipulation: current timestamps, date arithmetic, duration calculations, format conversions. Essential for time-based testing and scheduling.
story.arc: Learn to get current date/time, add and subtract time durations, calculate time differences, format dates for display, and build time-based test logic.
